source:
@@U04035@@
Ah, yes, indeed!
Priests!
Securing their well-stuffed bellies.
After all, they had more to lose than anyone.
The insurrection grew,
they blessed the rebels,
and our Emperor,
whom we so lately entertained,
comes here to fight—
perhaps his last battle.
translation:
@@U04035@@
啊，是的，确实如此！
牧师们！
确保他们的肚子饱饱的。
毕竟，他们的损失比任何人都多。
起义愈演愈烈，
他们祝福叛逆者，
还有我们的皇帝，
我们最近招待了他们，
来这里战斗——
也许是他的最后一场战斗。
